arithmetic_check: CHARGES. Substrate methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60: 34.5 g at 99.0% is 34.155 g, which is 0.09999 mol against the printed 0.1 mol, closes. Sodium hydroxide NaOH, MW 40.00: 4.04 g at 99% is 4.000 g, which is 0.09999 mol against 0.1 mol, closes. THE ONE FAILURE, AND THE ONLY ARITHMETIC DEFECT IN THE SECTION: 0.226g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.001mol). Triethylenediamine is 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, C6H12N2, MW 112.17. 0.226 g at 99% is 0.2237 g, which is 0.001995 mol, essentially twice the printed 0.001 mol; the discrepancy is a factor of 1.995, far outside any rounding of figures printed to three decimal places. Read the other way, 0.2237 g over the printed 0.001 mol implies a molecular weight of 223.7 against the true 112.17, again a factor of essentially two. The mass that would carry the printed 0.001 mol is 0.113 g. Neither figure repairs the other, both are recorded exactly as printed, mass_g 0.226 and mmol 1.0, and molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Note for A5: this is the same defect, and the same factor of two, that Example 4 carries on its 2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol) charge, and Example 2 carries a smaller version of it on 1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol); the triethylenediamine charge is the one figure this patent gets wrong repeatedly. Printed 31.58 g at the printed 99.3% assay is 31.36 g, which is 90.46% of theory against a printed 90.5%, a difference of 0.04 of a point. CLOSES. No mass_balance_implausible. The purities also disagree across the handover, isolated at 98.0% and charged at 99.0%, which no flag in the closed list covers and which is recorded in notes instead. All numbers recorded exactly as printed and none inferred. TEMPERATURE, RECORDED HERE FOR THE VERIFICATION PASS: the step prints two, 0 to 5 C on the etherification and 70 to 75 C on the alkaline hydrolysis. The structured field carries 70 to 75, taken from the final transformation per rule 9 and matching what Examples 1, 2 and 4 carry on the same step; the 0 to 5 C of the etherification is in one_pot_steps and in notes. This example is the only one of the four that runs the etherification under cooling, so that number is the section's distinguishing condition and is not to be dropped.
